mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) )
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{currentMonthStart}

SELECT DISTINCT assignment.user_id FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment WHERE assignment.assign_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assignment.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND assignment.evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND assignment.base_amount IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_challenge_monthly_report monthly_report WHERE monthly_report.user_id = assignment.user_id AND monthly_report.year_month = #{yearMonth} )
ORDER BY assignment.user_id

SELECT assignment.assign_date, assignment.result, mission.mission_type, mission.category_id, category.category_name, difficulty.difficulty_name, difficulty.score AS difficulty_score, assignment.base_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN mission_transaction.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(mission_transaction.refunded_amount, mission_transaction.amount) ELSE mission_transaction.amount END ) FROM tbl_transaction mission_transaction WHERE mission_transaction.user_id = assignment.user_id AND mission_transaction.category_id = mission.category_id AND mission_transaction.tr_date = assignment.assign_date AND mission_transaction.classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND mission_transaction.direction = 'OUT' AND mission_transaction.is_excluded_from_summary = 0 ), 0) AS actual_amount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info previous_assignment WHERE previous_assignment.user_id = assignment.user_id AND previous_assignment.assign_date = DATE_SUB(assignment.assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND previous_assignment.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AS previous_success FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id LEFT JOIN tbl_category category ON category.id = mission.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_mission_difficulty difficulty ON difficulty.id = assignment.difficulty_id WHERE assignment.user_id = #{userId} AND assignment.assign_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assignment.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND assignment.evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND assignment.base_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY assignment.assign_date, assignment.id
SELECT difficulty_name FROM tbl_mission_difficulty ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_challenge_monthly_report (user_id, `year_month`, total_days, success_days, saved_amount, over_amount, category_results_json, monthly_longest_streak, best_weekday, earned_score, weekly_results_json, difficulty_results_json, calculation_version, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{totalDays}, #{successDays}, #{savedAmount}, #{overspentAmount}, CAST(#{categoryEffectsJson} AS JSON), #{monthlyLongestStreak}, #{bestWeekday}, #{earnedScore}, CAST(#{weeklyResultsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{difficultyResultsJson} AS JSON), #{calculationVersion}, #{finalizedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_days = VALUES(total_days), success_days = VALUES(success_days), saved_amount = VALUES(saved_amount), over_amount = VALUES(over_amount), category_results_json = VALUES(category_results_json), monthly_longest_streak = VALUES(monthly_longest_streak), best_weekday = VALUES(best_weekday), earned_score = VALUES(earned_score), weekly_results_json = VALUES(weekly_results_json), difficulty_results_json = VALUES(difficulty_results_json), calculation_version = VALUES(calculation_version)
mapper.select: SELECT `year_month`, total_days, success_days, saved_amount, over_amount AS overspent_amount, net_amount, category_results_json AS category_effects_json, monthly_longest_streak, best_weekday, earned_score, weekly_results_json, difficulty_results_json FROM tbl_challenge_monthly_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `year_month` < #{yearMonth} ORDER BY `year_month` DESC LIMIT 1
